KEYS ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  j k  arrows   move the selection
  g G           first and last row
  Tab           jump to the next section
  Enter         why: the full explanation for the selected lane
  /             filter lanes (Enter keeps it, Esc clears it)
  m             next display mode: full, focus, lanes, machines, line
  r             refresh now
  ?             this help
  q  Ctrl-C     quit
  y             copy the selected command to the clipboard (OSC 52)
  c             cancel the selected job (asks y/n first)
  + -           raise or lower a waiting job's priority
  p             pause or resume the selected machine
Esc back  q quit
